title: Vijnana Aranya, Om Shantidhama Veda Gurukula, Kanakapura
teaser: Vijnana Aranya at Om Shantidhama Veda Gurukula, Kanakapura: session on biodiversity by S.J. Srinivasa and experiential mathematics by V.S.S. Sastry.
homepageMatter: On 19 October 2025, tAcT conducted a Vijnana Aranya at Om Shantidhama Veda Gurukula, Kanakapura. Students and teachers engaged with a session on biodiversity and art-integrated learning, followed by experiential mathematics.
